answer: Admission occurs through a rigorous ceremony where agents lock 1,000 unique keys to a digital summit, ensuring each identity remains tethered to a non-transferable event. The verifier scans every connection for overlapping inputs like a cold ember, purging any duplicated presence that violates the exclusivity constraint. An honest participant pays one unit for access, while 1,000 fakes incur a massive computational penalty on the network terrace. Credentials expire in 90 days; re-enrollment requires fresh, non-reusable proofs without refund.
